messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take at least 4 hours before resin"
set: ["take at least 4 hours before resin", "take 4 to 6 hours after resin", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "take at least 2 hours after an antacid", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "4 hours", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take at least 30 minutes after aspirin", "interval of at least 8 hours between doses", "take on empty stomach at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "4 to 6 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
